description:
Why You Hear ZERO Sound Inside Outer Space! — Blast a giant horn in outer space—why would nobody beside you hear 1 single beep?
Kids science answer for "why is space silent for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Sound travels as vibrations bumping through air molecules; because outer space is mostly an empty vacuum, sound waves cannot travel there.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
